info.name: Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha
info.plot: Una professionista lascia il suo studio dentistico a Seoul e si trasferisce in un villaggio sul mare. Lì incontra un residente locale che è disoccupato ma sembra fare di tutto in città, dall'aiutare i bisognosi all'essere parte della vita di tutti. I due si interessano a vicenda nonostante le loro differenze.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.plot: Things look bleak for Yoon Hye-jin after she quits her job. On a trip to Gongjin, she runs into a series of unfortunate events — and one unusual local.

translations.value: Things look bleak for Yoon Hye-jin after she quits her job. On a trip to Gongjin, she runs into a series of unfortunate events — and one unusual local.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.plot: Hye-jin gets ready to welcome patients. But when a mishap at a party lands her in the town's bad graces, she needs guidance from Hong Du-sik.

translations.value: Hye-jin gets ready to welcome patients. But when a mishap at a party lands her in the town's bad graces, she needs guidance from Hong Du-sik.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.plot: A long drive to Seoul with Du-sik and other uninvited passengers tests Hye-jin's patience. Despite pain in her teeth, Kim Gam-ri refuses treatment.

translations.value: A long drive to Seoul with Du-sik and other uninvited passengers tests Hye-jin's patience. Despite pain in her teeth, Kim Gam-ri refuses treatment.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.plot: When a patient causes a disturbance at the office, Du-sik comes to the rescue. Elsewhere, Chang Yeong-guk learns that his first love is back in town.

translations.value: When a patient causes a disturbance at the office, Du-sik comes to the rescue. Elsewhere, Chang Yeong-guk learns that his first love is back in town.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.plot: Hye-jin is seen leaving Du-sik's home one morning. While she tries to recall what happened the night before, the town's gossip mill goes into overdrive.

translations.value: Hye-jin is seen leaving Du-sik's home one morning. While she tries to recall what happened the night before, the town's gossip mill goes into overdrive.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.plot: Hye-jin resolves to stop getting involved with Du-sik. Oh Ju-ri enters a singing competition in an attempt to win money to fix her snaggletooth.

translations.value: Hye-jin resolves to stop getting involved with Du-sik. Oh Ju-ri enters a singing competition in an attempt to win money to fix her snaggletooth.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.plot: Preparing to film his TV show in Gongjin, Ji Seong-hyeon has the perfect guide and house in mind — but getting them takes extra convincing.

translations.value: Preparing to film his TV show in Gongjin, Ji Seong-hyeon has the perfect guide and house in mind — but getting them takes extra convincing.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.plot: Du-sik catches a nasty cold. Hye-jin notices a troubling trend among her patients. A kidnapper on the loose puts the town on high alert.

translations.value: Du-sik catches a nasty cold. Hye-jin notices a troubling trend among her patients. A kidnapper on the loose puts the town on high alert.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.plot: Du-sik puts on a show pretending to be Hye-jin's boyfriend in front of her visiting parents. Seong-hyeon makes a good impression on her father.

translations.value: Du-sik puts on a show pretending to be Hye-jin's boyfriend in front of her visiting parents. Seong-hyeon makes a good impression on her father.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.plot: Following an intruder attack in her home, a shaken Hye-jin leans on Du-sik. She's left more conflicted than ever after Seong-hyeon asks to talk.

translations.value: Following an intruder attack in her home, a shaken Hye-jin leans on Du-sik. She's left more conflicted than ever after Seong-hyeon asks to talk.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.plot: Before Hye-jin makes things official with Du-sik, there's something she needs to do first. Attempts to keep their relationship a secret backfire on them.

translations.value: Before Hye-jin makes things official with Du-sik, there's something she needs to do first. Attempts to keep their relationship a secret backfire on them.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.plot: Hye-jin compiles a long bucket list of activities she wants to experience with Du-sik. Pyo Mi-seon and Choi Eun-cheol finally arrive on the same page.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.plot: As Du-sik continues to keep his past shrouded in mystery, Hye-jin grows frustrated. Ham Yun-gyeong is struck by an emergency during a typhoon.

translations.value: As Du-sik continues to keep his past shrouded in mystery, Hye-jin grows frustrated. Ham Yun-gyeong is struck by an emergency during a typhoon.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.plot: Hye-jin and Du-sik take some time apart. Yu Cho-hui urges Yeong-guk to have courage about his feelings. Seong-hyeon and his team wrap up filming.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.plot: With his secrets out in the open, Du-sik must find a way to move on from the tragedies of his past. Hye-jin considers an enticing job offer.

translations.value: With his secrets out in the open, Du-sik must find a way to move on from the tragedies of his past. Hye-jin considers an enticing job offer.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.plot: The town gathers to bid goodbye to a loved one. Hye-jin plans an unforgettable event for Du-sik, but it turns out he had the same idea.

translations.title: Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha
translations.overview: A big-city dentist opens up a practice in a close-knit seaside village, home to a charming jack-of-all-trades who is her polar opposite in every way.
translations.tagline: Eventually, we found each other once again.

translations.title: 갯마을 차차차
translations.overview: 현실주의 치과의사 윤혜진과 만능 백수 홍반장이 짠내 사람내음 가득한 바닷마을 공진에서 벌이는 티키타카 힐링 로맨스. 대도시 생활을 접은 치과의사가 바닷가 마을에서 병원을 개업한다. 끈끈하기 그지없는 이 동네, 그곳에서 만난 만능 백수 히어로. 모든 면에서 그녀와 정반대를 달리는데, 은근히 매력이 넘친다?
